mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM attachment a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.id = #{id}
SELECT a.* FROM attachment a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attachment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND url = #{url}) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM attachment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND url = #{url} AND (scan_state != 'clean' OR scan_engine IS NULL OR scan_database_version IS NULL OR scanned_at IS NULL OR (scan_database_version = 'disabled' AND NOT #{allowDisabledProof}) OR (scan_database_version != 'disabled' AND (scan_expires_at IS NULL OR scan_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))))
mapper.update: UPDATE attachment a JOIN attachment target ON target.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND target.url = a.url SET a.scan_state = 'quarantined', a.scan_owner = NULL, a.scan_lease_until = NULL WHERE target.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND target.id = #{id}

UPDATE attachment a JOIN attachment target ON target.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND target.url = a.url SET a.scan_state = 'pending', a.scan_owner = NULL, a.scan_lease_until = NULL, a.scan_next_attempt_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE target.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND target.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id FROM attachment FORCE INDEX (idx_attachment_workspace) ORDER BY workspace_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(id) FROM attachment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND url LIKE '/api/attachments/content/%' GROUP BY url HAVING SUM(scan_state = 'quarantined') = 0 AND SUM(scan_state = 'scanning' AND scan_lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) = 0 AND SUM((scan_state IN ('pending', 'error', 'scanning') OR (scan_state = 'clean' AND (scan_expires_at IS NULL OR scan_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))) AND (scan_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR scan_next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) > 0 ORDER BY MIN(COALESCE(scan_next_attempt_at, CASE WHEN scan_state = 'clean' THEN scan_expires_at END, created_at)), MIN(id) LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AND SUM(scan_state = 'quarantined') = 0 AND SUM(scan_state = 'scanning' AND scan_lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) = 0 AND SUM((scan_state IN ('pending', 'error', 'scanning') OR (scan_state = 'clean' AND (scan_expires_at IS NULL OR scan_expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))) AND (scan_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR scan_next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) > 0 FROM attachment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND url = #{url}
mapper.update: UPDATE attachment SET scan_state = 'scanning', scan_owner = #{owner}, scan_lease_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE), scan_attempts = scan_attempts + 1, scan_last_attempt_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND url = #{url}

UPDATE attachment SET scan_state = 'error', scan_owner = NULL, scan_lease_until = NULL, scan_next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL LEAST(3600, 30 * scan_attempts) SECOND) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND url = #{url} AND scan_owner = #{owner} AND scan_state = 'scanning'
